families.label: Real Estate Development, Ownership and Investment
families.definition: Development, ownership, leasing, investment, portfolio management, and public-market operation of residential and commercial real estate assets.

capabilities.label: Real estate development
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to acquire, entitle, finance, design, construct, position, and deliver land or property development projects for market use.

capabilities.label: Residential development and homebuilding
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to acquire sites, plan communities, finance, construct, market, and deliver housing units or residential developments.

capabilities.label: Commercial property ownership and leasing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to own, position, lease, operate, and steward income-producing commercial or institutional real property.

capabilities.label: Real estate investment management
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to source, underwrite, acquire, finance, manage, reposition, and dispose of real estate investments for an owner or investment vehicle.

capabilities.label: Real estate investment trust operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate a real estate investment trust with portfolio, capital, distribution, compliance, governance, and investor-reporting systems.
